label: B220-positive CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell
definition: A B220-positive CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell is a CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell that has the phenotype B220-positive, CD38-positive, IgD-positive, CD138-negative, and IgG-negative.

label: B220-low CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell
definition: A B220-low CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell is a CD38-positive unswitched memory B cell that has the phenotype B220-low, CD38-positive, IgD-positive, CD138-negative, and IgG-negative.

label: IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
definition: A class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface.
exact_synonyms: IgG- class switched memory B cell|IgG- class switched memory B lymphocyte|IgG- class switched memory B-cell|IgG- class switched memory B-lymphocyte|IgG-negative class switched memory B lymphocyte|IgG-negative class switched memory B-cell|IgG-negative class switched memory B-lymphocyte

label: CD38-negative IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
definition: A CD38-negative IgG-negative memory B cell is a IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype CD38-negative and IgG-negative.

label: CD38-positive IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
definition: A CD38-positive IgG-negative memory B cell is an IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype CD38-positive and IgG-negative.

label: CD24-positive CD38-negative IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
definition: An CD24-positive CD38-negative IgG-negative memory B cell is a CD38-negative IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype CD24-positive, CD38-negative, and IgG-negative.

label: CD24-negative CD38-negative IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
definition: A CD24-negative CD38-negative IgG-negative memory B cell is a CD38-negative IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype CD24-negative, CD38-negative, and IgG-negative.

label: B220-positive CD38-positive IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
definition: A B220-positive CD38-positive IgG-negative memory B cell is a CD38-positive IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype B220-positive, CD38-positive, and IgG-negative.

label: B220-low CD38-positive IgG-negative class switched memory B cell
definition: A B220-low CD38-positive IgG-negative memory B cell is a CD38-positive IgG-negative class switched memory B cell that lacks IgG on the cell surface with the phenotype B220-low, CD38-positive, and IgG-positive.

label: CD27-positive gamma-delta T cell
definition: A circulating gamma-delta T cell that is CD27-positive and capable of producing IFN-gamma.

label: CD27-negative gamma-delta T cell
definition: A circulating gamma-delta T cell that expresses RORgamma(t), is CD27-negative and is capable of IL-17 secretion.

label: CD25-positive, CD27-positive immature gamma-delta T cell
definition: A CD25-positive, CD27-positive immature gamma-delta T cell found in the thymus that has an immature phenotype (i.e. CD24-high, CD25-high, CD62L-high, CD44-high, CD2-low, CD5-low).

label: innate effector T cell
definition: A T cell with a receptor of limited diversity that is capable of immediate effector functions upon stimulation.

label: Tc17 cell
definition: A CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell that has the phenotype CXCR3-negative, CCR6-positive, CCR5-high, CD45RA-negative, and capable of producing IL-17 and some IFNg.
exact_synonyms: CD8-positive Th17 cell|Tc17 T cell|Tc17 T lymphocyte|Tc17 T-cell|Tc17 T-lymphocyte|Th17 CD8-positive T cell|Th17 non-TFH CD8-positive T cell|Tc17 CD8+ T cell

label: regular atrial cardiac myocyte
definition: Regular cardiac myocyte of a cardiac atrium.
exact_synonyms: atrial myocyte|regular atrial cardiac muscle fiber|regular cardiac muscle cell of atrium|atrial cardiac muscle cell

label: regular interatrial cardiac myocyte
definition: A cardiac myocyte of the interatrial region of the heart.

label: regular ventricular cardiac myocyte
definition: Regular cardiac myocyte of a cardiac ventricle.
exact_synonyms: regular cardiac muscle cell of ventricle|regular ventricular cardiac muscle fiber|ventricular myocyte

label: stromal cell of ovary
definition: A stomal cell of the ovary

label: stromal cell of ovarian cortex
definition: A stromal cell of the ovarian cortex.

label: stromal cell of ovarian medulla
definition: A stromal cell of the ovarian medulla.

label: nonkeratinized cell of epidermis
definition: Epidermal cells that do not contain keratin. Cell type is usually associated with moist epidermal tissues.

label: type II cell of adrenal cortex
definition: A cell in the zona fasciculata that produce glucocorticoids, e.g cortisol.
exact_synonyms: type II cortical cell of adrenal gland

label: type III cell of adrenal cortex
definition: A cell in the zona reticularis that produce sex hormones.

label: endothelial cell of lymphatic vessel
definition: A endothelial cell of a lymphatic vessel. The border of the oak leaf-shaped endothelial cell of initial lymphatics are joined by specialized buttons. The discontinuous feature of buttons distinguishes them from zippers in collecting lymphatics, but both types of junctions are composed of proteins typical of adherens junctions and tight junctions found in the endothelium of blood vessels. Buttons seal the sides of flaps of the oak leaf-shaped endothelial cell, leaving open the tips of flaps as routes for fluid entry without disassembly and reformation of intercellular junctions.

label: endothelial cell of vascular tree
definition: An endothelial cell of the vascular tree, which includes blood vessels and lymphatic vessels.
other_synonyms: cubodial endothelial cell of vascular tree

label: skin sebocyte
definition: An acinar cell that is part of a skin sebaceous gland. This cell produces and secretes sebum into hair follicles.
exact_synonyms: acinar cell of skin sebaceous gland

label: active chief cell of parathyroid gland
definition: A parathyroid chief cell that is actively secreting hormone. Have large Golgi complexes with numerous vesicles and small membrane-bound granules; secretory granules are rare, cytoplasmic glycogen sparse, much of the cytoplasm being occupied by flat sacs of granular endoplasmic reticulum in parallel arrays; in normal humans, inactive chief cells outnumber active chief cells in a ratio of 3-5:1

label: dark cell of eccrine sweat gland
definition: A cell pyramidal in shape, with their broad ends facing and forming the greater extent of the lining of the main lumen. Secretes glycoproteins associated with mucus.

label: dark chief cell of parathyroid gland
definition: A chief cell that is smaller than light chief cells and has a smaller and darker nucleus and a finely granular cytoplasm with many granules.

label: capillary endothelial cell
definition: An endothelial cell found in capillaries.

label: multiciliated columnar cell of tracheobronchial tree
definition: A multi-ciliated epithelial cell located in the trachea and bronchi, characterized by a columnar shape and motile cilia on its apical surface. These cilia facilitate mucociliary clearance by moving mucus and trapped particles toward the pharynx.
exact_synonyms: ciliated columnar cell of tracheobronchial tree

label: clear cell of eccrine sweat gland
definition: A sweat producing cell of eccrine sweat glands. Pyramidal in shape, with its base resting on the basal lamina or myoepitheliocytes, and its microvillus-covered apical plasma membrane line up the intercellular canaliculi. Cell is not stained by hematoxylin or eosin.

label: clear chief cell of parathyroid gland
definition: A chief cell of parathyroid glands that does not stain with hematoxylin or eosin. This cell is larger, has a larger nucleus and fewer secretory granules than dark chief cells.
exact_synonyms: clear chief cell of parathyroid cell

label: dental pulp cell
definition: A cell found within the dental pulp.

label: epithelial cell of uterus
definition: An epithelial cell of the uterus. This cell has a mesodermal origin.

label: epithelioid macrophage
definition: Epithelioid macrophage is an activated macrophage that resembles an epithelial cell with finely granular, pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and central, ovoid nucleus (oval or elongate). This cell type is able to merge into one another to form aggregates. The presence of such aggregates may characterize some pathologic conditions, mainly granulomatous inflammation.

label: late promyelocyte
definition: A promyelocyte that is considerably smaller, with more condensed chromatin, and nucleoli are no longer conspicuous.

label: columnar cell of endocervix
definition: A simple columnar epithelial cell located in the endocervix.

label: corneocyte
definition: The dead keratin-filled squamous cell of the stratum corneum. This cell type lacks a nucleus.

label: early promyelocyte
definition: A promyelocyte with a nucleus that is indented and contains more marginated heterochromatin compared to its precursor cell (myeloblast); cytoplasm is deeply basophilic and contains numerous mitochondria and meandering cysternae of endoplasmic reticulum; largest of the granulocyte lineages.

label: echinocyte
definition: A crenated erythrocyte with 30+ crenations, bumps or spurs that are the result of damage due to age or disease.

label: endosteal cell
definition: A cell type that makes up the highly vascular membrane lining the marrow cavity of long bones.

label: external epithelial cell of tympanic membrane
definition: Epithelial cell found on the external side of the tympanic membrane

label: general ecto-epithelial cell
definition: Epithelial cells derived from general body ectoderm and ectoderm placodes.

label: basal external epithelial cell of tympanic membrane
definition: A cell type found in the basal epithelial layer on the external side of the tympanic membrane. Cell type is flattened with intracellular spaces of variable dimensions.

label: superficial external epithelial cell of tympanic membrane
definition: A cell type found on the superficial layer of the external side of the tympanic membrane. This cell-type lacks a nucleus.

label: internal epithelial cell of tympanic membrane
definition: An extremely flattened cell type found on the inner side of the tympanic membrane. The surface of this cell type carries sparse pleomorphic microvilli that are more common near the junctional zones.

label: internal pillar cell of cochlea
definition: A rod-shpaed cell that forms a single row adjacent to and supporting the inner hair cells.

label: external pillar cell of cochlea
definition: A rod-shaped cell found in 3 or 4 rows that lie adjacent to and support the outer hair cells.

label: phalangeal cell
definition: A supporting cell that is attached to the basement membrane and forms rows that support the hair cells.

label: epithelial cell of Malassez
definition: An epithelial cell that remains from the disintegration of the epithelial root sheath involved in the development of teeth.
exact_synonyms: epithelial cell rests of Malassez|epithelial debris of Malassez

label: olfactory epithelial cell
definition: A specialized cell involved in sensory perception of smell.

label: border cell of cochlea
definition: A border cell is a slender columnar cell on the medial portion of the basilar membrane.

label: basal cell of olfactory epithelium
definition: An epithelial cell located on the basal lamina of the olfactory epithelium.

label: keratinized cell of the oral mucosa
definition: A keratinized cell located in the hard palate or gingiva.

label: globose cell of olfactory epithelium
definition: A rounded or elliptical epithelial cell, with pale-staining open face nucleus and pale cytoplasm rich in free ribosomes and clusters of centrioles; form a distinct basal zone spaced slightly from the basal surface of the epithelium.

label: interdental cell of cochlea
definition: A long, spindle-shaped supporting cells arranged in parallel rows that secretes components of the tectorial membrane and potassium ions into the endolymph.

label: extraglomerular mesangial cell
definition: A cell that is a specialized type of pericyte providing structural support for the capillary loops of kidney. A flat, elongated cell with extensive fine cytoplasmic processes found outside the kidney glomerulus near the macula densa and bound laterally by afferent and efferent arterioles. Being phagocytic, this cell participates in the continuous turnover of the basal lamina by removing its outer portion containing residues of filtration, while the lamina is renewed on its inner surface by the endothelial cells.

label: follicular cell of ovary
definition: A cell within the follicle of an ovary.

label: primary follicular cell of ovary
definition: A cell within the primary follicle of the ovary.

label: secondary follicular cell of ovary
definition: A cell of a secondary follicile within the ovary.

label: folliculostellate cell of pars distalis of adenohypophysis
definition: A supporting cell of the anterior pituitary gland involved in trophic and catabolic processes; expresses a broad spectrum of cytokeratins indicative of their epithelial nature.
exact_synonyms: folliculostellate cell of pars anterior of adenohypophysis

label: epithelial cell of stomach
definition: An epithelial cell found in the lining of the stomach.

label: foveolar cell of stomach
definition: A simple columnar cell that populates the entire luminal surface including the gastric pits. This cell types secrete mucus to form a thick protective, lubricant layer over the gastric wall.

label: mucous cell of stomach
definition: An epithelial cell of the stomach. This cell produces mucous.

label: mucous neck cell of gastric gland
definition: A columnar epithelial mucous secreting cell located in the neck of the gastric glands. These cells have numerous apical secretory vesicles containing mucins and a basally displaced nucleus. The mucous they secrete is distinct histochemically from that of the surface mucous cells of stomach.

label: stem cell of gastric gland
definition: A stomach epithelial cell that is olumnar in form with a few short apical microvilli; relatively undifferentiated mitotic cell from which other types of gland are derived; few in number, situated in the isthmus region of the gland and base of the gastric pit.

label: basal proper cell of olfactory epithelium
definition: A flat or angular epithelial cell with condensed nuclei and darkly staining cytoplasm containing numerous intermediate filaments inserted into desmosomes contacting surrounding supporting cells; lie in contact with the basal lamina of olfactory epithelium.

label: basal cell of epidermis
definition: A mitotically active, columnar-shaped keratinocyte located in the stratum basale of the epidermis and attached to the basement membrane. This cell exhibits heterogeneity, encompassing stem and progenitor subpopulations with distinct molecular and proliferative characteristics (Haensel et al., 2020), and serves as the primary source of new keratinocytes for epidermal renewal, homeostasis, and regeneration.

label: glomerular endothelial cell
definition: An endothelial cell that is part of the glomerulus of the kidney. This cell is flattened, highly fenestrated, and plays a vital role in the formation of glomerular ultrafiltrate.

label: granular cell of epidermis
definition: A keratinocyte located in the stratum granulosum of the epidermis, characterized by the presence of keratohyalin granules containing filaggrin—which aggregate keratin filament —and by lamellar granules that secrete lipids and enzymes essential for forming the skin’s waterproof barrier. As these cells progress toward the surface, they adopt a flattened morphology and initiate keratinization to become corneocyte and form the protective stratum corneum. In human epidermis, granular keratinocytes are transcriptomically distinguished by high expression of differentiation markers such as DSC1, KRT2, IVL, and TGM3 (Wang et al., 2020), and LOR, FLG, and SPINK5 (Cheng et al., 2018).

label: squamous cell of epidermis
definition: A flat keratinocyte immediately below the cornified layer.

label: granulocytopoietic cell
definition: A cell involved in the formation of a granulocyte.

label: metamyelocyte
definition: A eosinophil precursor in the granulocytic series, being a cell intermediate in development between a myelocyte and a band form cell. The nucleus becomes indented where the indentation is smaller than half the distance to the farthest nuclear margin; chromatin becomes coarse and clumped; specific granules predominate while primary granules are rare.

label: myelocyte
definition: A cell type that is the first of the maturation stages of the granulocytic leukocytes normally found in the bone marrow. Granules are seen in the cytoplasm. The nuclear material of the myelocyte is denser than that of the myeloblast but lacks a definable membrane. The cell is flat and contains increasing numbers of granules as maturation progresses.

label: monopoietic cell
definition: A cell involved in the formation of a monocyte (monopoiesis).

label: hepatic stem cell
definition: A stem cell that can give rise to the cells of the liver. The term usually refers to the self-renewing pool of hepatocyte precursors in the adult liver (differently from 'hepatoblast', often used for fetal precursors of hepatocytes).

label: hepatic oval stem cell
definition: A transient hepatic stem cell observed after liver injury with a high nuclear to cytoplasm ratio that can differentiate into mature hepatocytes and bile duct cells. Arises from more than one tissue.
exact_synonyms: hepatic oval cell|hepatic progenitor cell|liver progenitor cell

label: inactive chief cell of parathyoid gland
definition: A parathyroid chief cell that is not actively secreting hormone. Contains small Golgi complexes with only a few grouped vesicles and membrane-bound secretory granules; glycogen and many lipofuscin granules abound but sacs of granular endoplasmic reticulum are rare and dispersed. In normal humans, inactive chief cells out number active chief cells in a ratio of 3-5:1.

label: oncocyte
definition: A large epithelial cell with an extremely acidophilic and granular cytoplasm, containing vast numbers of mitochondria; such cells may undergo neoplastic transformation. From the Greek word onkos meaning swelling, this cell type is found in parathyroid, salivary and thyroid glands.

label: oxyphil cell of parathyroid gland
definition: An oncocyte located in the parathyroid gland.

label: oxyphil cell of thyroid
definition: An oncocyte located in the thyroid.

label: renal beta-intercalated cell
definition: A renal intercalated cell that secretes base and reabsorbs acid in the distal segments of the kidney tubule to maintain acid/base balance.

label: epithelial cell of tracheobronchial tree
definition: An epithelial cell of the tracheobronchial tree.

label: tuft cell of large intestine
definition: A tuft cell that is part of the epithelium of large intestine.
exact_synonyms: brush cell of epithelium proper of large intestine|brush cell of large intestine|tuft cell of epithelium of large intestine

label: tuft cell
definition: An epithelial cell found in various organs, including the gastrointestinal and respiratory tracts, characterized by a tuft of 120-140 blunt microvilli on its apical surface. This cell exhibits diverse functions depending on its location, which includes chemosensation, initiation of immune responses, contribution to mucociliary clearance, and defense against parasites.
exact_synonyms: brush cell|caveolated cell|fibrillovesicular cell|multivesicular cell|peculiar cell

label: brush cell of lobular bronchiole
definition: A brush cell found in the epithelium of lobular bronchiole.

label: brush cell of terminal bronchiole
definition: A brush cell of the epithelium in the terminal bronchiole.

label: brush cell of trachea
definition: Brush cell of the epithelium in the trachea.

label: brush cell of bronchus
definition: A brush cell found in the epithelium of bronchus.

label: intermediate epitheliocyte
definition: An epithelial cell present in the trachea and bronchi; columnar in shape; generally lack cilia; immature forms of ciliated or secretory cells which have been formed from stem cells.
exact_synonyms: undifferentiated columnar cell of tracheobronchial tree

label: red muscle cell
definition: A slow muscle cell that contains high levels of myoglobin and oxygen storing proteins giving the cell a red appearance.

label: type I muscle cell
definition: A slow muscle cell that has large amounts of myoglobin, stores energy as triglycerides, generates ATP by the oxidative method and is resistant to fatigue.
exact_synonyms: slow twitch fiber|slow twitch muscle cell|type 1 muscle cell|type 1 muscle fiber|type I muscle fiber|slow twitch muscle fiber|slow-twitch muscle fiber

label: type II muscle cell
definition: A fast muscle fiber cell that stores energy in the form of glycogen and creatine phosphate.
exact_synonyms: type 2 muscle cell|type 2 muscle fiber|type II muscle fiber

label: white muscle cell
definition: A muscle cell with low content of myoglobin and other oxygen storing proteins. This muscle cell has a white appearance.

label: type IIa muscle cell
definition: A type II muscle cell that contains large amounts of myoglobin, has many mitochondria and very many blood capillaries. Type II A cells are red, have a very high capacity for generating ATP by oxidative metabolic processes, split ATP at a very rapid rate, have a fast contraction velocity and are resistant to fatigue.
exact_synonyms: fast twitch A|fatigue resistant fast twitch muscle cell|type 2a muscle cell|type 2a muscle fiber|type IIa muscle fiber

label: type IIb muscle cell
definition: A type II muscle cell that contains a low content of myoglobin, relatively few mitochondria, relatively few blood capillaries and large amounts of glycogen. Type II B fibres are white, geared to generate ATP by anaerobic metabolic processes, not able to supply skeletal muscle fibres continuously with sufficient ATP, fatigue easily, split ATP at a fast rate and have a fast contraction velocity.
exact_synonyms: type 2b muscle cell|type 2b muscle fiber|type IIb muscle fiber

label: intermediate muscle cell
definition: An intermediate muscle cell that has characteristics of both fast and slow muscle cells.

label: intermediate trophoblast cell
definition: A trophoblast that leaves the placenta and invades the endometrium and myometrium. This cell type is crucial in increasing blood flow to the fetus.

label: immature dendritic epithelial T cell precursor
definition: A double negative thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that has as part a Vgamma3 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive. This cell-type is found in the fetal thymus with highest numbers occurring at E17-E18.

label: anchoring trophoblast
definition: A trophoblast found at the junction of the placenta. This cell type makes a unique fibronectin-trophouteronectin junction that helps mediate attachment of the placenta to the uterus. This cell type is also found junction of the chorion layer of the external membranes and the decidua.

label: interstitial cell of pineal gland
definition: A cell located between the pinealocytes.

label: keratinized squamous cell of esophagus
definition: A squamous cell that has keratin in the esophagus.

label: vertebrate lens cell
definition: A cell comprising the transparent, biconvex body separating the posterior chamber and vitreous body, and constituting part of the refracting mechanism of the mammalian eye.

label: anterior lens cell
definition: A cell of the transparent layer of simple cuboidal epithelium over the anterior surface of the lens; transform into lens fiber(s).

label: lens epithelial cell
definition: A cell of the cuboidal epithelium that covers the lens. The cells of the lens epithelium regulate most of the homeostatic functions of the lens. As ions, nutrients, and liquid enter the lens from the aqueous humor, Na+/K+ ATPase pumps in the lens epithelial cells pump ions out of the lens to maintain appropriate lens osmolarity and volume, with equatorially positioned lens epithelium cells contributing most to this current. The activity of the Na+/K+ ATPases keeps water and current flowing through the lens from the poles and exiting through the equatorial regions. The cells of the lens epithelium also serve as the progenitors for new lens fibers. It constantly lays down fibers in the embryo, fetus, infant, and adult, and continues to lay down fibers for lifelong growth.

label: secondary lens fiber
definition: A lens fiber cell that develops from primary lens fiber; located towards the center of lens; cell organelles are normally degraded or in the process of being degraded.

label: non-nucleated secondary lens fiber
definition: A secondary lens fiber cell that lacks a nucleus.

label: nucleated secondary lens fiber
definition: A secondary fiber cell that contains a nucleus.

label: primary lens fiber
definition: An elongating cell that rapidly obliterates the lumen of the lens vesicle. Subsequently, differentiation of this cell type at the lens equator leads to the formation of secondary fiber cells that come to overlie the primary fibers.

label: light chief cell of parathyroid gland
definition: A chief cell that is bigger than dark chief cells and has a larger and lighter nucleus and a cytoplasm with few granules.

label: epithelial cell of prostate
definition: An epithelial cell of the prostate.

label: epithelial cell of prostatic duct
definition: An epithelial cell of prostatic duct.

label: epithelial cell of prostatic acinus
definition: An epithelial cell of the prostatic acinus.

label: basal cell of prostatic acinus
definition: A cell of the basal layer of the epithelium in the prostatic acinus.
exact_synonyms: basal epithelial cell of prostatic acinus

label: luminal cell of prostatic acinus
definition: A cell of the luminal layer of the epithelium in the prostatic acinus.

label: basal epithelial cell of prostatic duct
definition: A cell that constitutes the basal layer of epithelium in the prostatic duct.

label: luminal epithelial cell of prostatic duct
definition: A cell that constitutes the luminal layer of epithelium of prostatic duct.

label: male gonocyte
definition: A primordial germ cell that is destined to become a male germ cell.
exact_synonyms: male primordial germ cell|testis primordial germ cell

label: ooblast
definition: A primordial cell from which an oocyte (ovum) ultimately is developed.

label: marrow fibroblast
definition: A fibroblast in the bone marrow.

label: pulmonary interstitial fibroblast
definition: A fibroblasts found in interstitial spaces in the pulmonary tract. Greater numbers of these cells are found in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

label: nucleate cell
definition: A cell containing at least one nucleus.

label: smooth muscle cell of sphincter of pupil
definition: A circular smooth muscle cell of the iris, innervated by the ciliary nerves (parasympathetic), and acting to contract the pupil. This muscle cell derives from neuroectoderm. This smooth muscle cell results from transformation of epithelial cells to smooth muscle cells.
exact_synonyms: smooth muscle fiber of sphincter of pupil
other_synonyms: smooth muscle fibre of sphincter of pupil

label: squamous cell of ectocervix
definition: A stratified squamous epithelial cell located in the ectocervix.

label: peripheral blood stem cell
definition: A hematopoeitic stem cell found in the blood. Normally found in very limited numbers in the peripheral circulation (less than 0.1% of all nucleated cells).

label: pleural macrophage
definition: A tissue macrophage that is in the pleural space.

label: pluripotent stem cell
definition: A pluripotent stem cell has the ability to form cells from all three germ layers (ectoderm, mesoderm, and endoderm). However, unlike totipotent stem cells, they cell can not generate all the cells of the whole organism such as placenta.

label: primitive cardiac myocyte
definition: A stem cell that can differentiate into a cardiac myocyte.

label: intestinal crypt stem cell
definition: A stem cell located in epithelium the based of the crypt of Lieberkuhn. Division of these cells serve both to maintain the stem cell population and produce the transit amplifying cells that are all precursors of all cell types that populate the intestinal epithelium.
exact_synonyms: stem cell of intestinal crypt of Lieberkuhn

label: epithelial cell of alimentary canal
definition: An epithelial cell of the musculomembranous digestive tube extending from the mouth to the anus.

label: epithelial cell of esophagus
definition: An epithelial cell of the lining of the esophagus.

label: epithelial cell of large intestine
definition: An epithelial cell of the lining of the large intestine.

label: epithelial cell of small intestine
definition: An epithelial cell of the lining of the small intestine.

label: stromal cell of endometrium
definition: A stromal cell of the endometrium, characterized by its fibroblast-like morphology, regenerative capacity, and ability to undergo decidualization. It differentiates into a decidual stromal cell during pregnancy, essential for embryo implantation and maintenance. This cell is involved in tissue proliferation, remodeling, and breakdown, responding to hormonal changes, particularly estrogen and progesterone.

label: supporting cell of carotid body
definition: A supportive cell that has characteristics of glial cell. Processes of this cell envelope the junctions between glomus cells and nerve endings.

label: epithelial cell of thyroid gland
definition: An epithelial cell of thyroid gland.

label: thyroid follicular cell
definition: An epithelial cell that is part of the thyroid follicle epithelium, with a shape that ranges from squamous when inactive to cuboidal or columnar when active, reflecting its hormonal activity. Its apical surface is lined with microvilli projecting into the colloid-filled lumen, where it synthesizes, stores, and secretes the thyroid hormones thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronine (T3), releasing them into the bloodstream in response to thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH).
exact_synonyms: follicular cell of thyroid gland|principal cell of thyroid gland|thyroid gland follicular cell|thyroid hormone secreting cell

label: neuroepithelial stem cell
definition: The stem cell from which glial precursor cell arises from.

label: epithelial cell of parathyroid gland
definition: An epithelial cell of the parathyroid gland.

label: endothelial cell of viscerocranial mucosa
definition: An endothelial cell found in the mucosa associated with the facial skeleton.

label: endothelial cell of sinusoid
definition: An endothelial cell that lines any of the venous cavities through which blood passes in various glands and organs such as the spleen and liver.

label: transitional cell of parathyroid gland
definition: One of three types of epithelial cells that populate the parathyroid gland; cytological characteristics intermediate between those of the chief cell and of the oxyphil cell. Because only one hormone is produced, the three cell forms are widely believed to be different phases in the life cycle of a single cell type, with the chief cell being its physiologically active stage.

label: type A cell of stomach
definition: A type of enteroendocrine cell found in the stomach that secretes glucagon.

label: type D cell of colon
definition: A D cell located in the colon.
exact_synonyms: colon D-cell|colonic delta cell|delta cell of colon

label: type D cell of small intestine
definition: A type D cell of the small intestine.
exact_synonyms: delta cell of small intestine|small intestine D-cell|small intestine delta cell

label: type D cell of stomach
definition: A type D cell found in the stomach.
exact_synonyms: delta cell of stomach|stomach D-cell|stomach delta cell

label: P/D1 enteroendocrine cell
definition: An enteroendocrine cell that stores and secretes Ghrelin.

label: vasoactive intestinal peptide secreting cell
definition: An endocrine cell that secretes vasoactive intestinal peptide.

label: type EC2 enteroendocrine cell
definition: A type EC enteroendocrine cell in the duodenum and jejunum that stores and secretes motilin and 5-hydroxytryptamine.

label: type EC1 enteroendocrine cell
definition: A type EC enteredocrine cell in the intestines that stores and secretes substance P and 5-hydroxytryptamine.

label: motilin secreting cell
definition: A cell that secretes motilin, a gastric hormone that at low pH inhibits gastric motor activity, whereas at high pH has a stimulating effect.

label: type ECL enteroendocrine cell
definition: A type EC enteroendocrine cell type that is numerous in the fundus of the stomach; stores 5-hydroxytryptamine and histamine.

label: histamine secreting cell
definition: A cell type that secretes histamine.

label: pancreatic PP cell
definition: A PP cell located in the islets of the pancreas.
exact_synonyms: PP cell of pancreatic islet|PP-cell of pancreatic islet|pancreatic polypeptide-secreting cell

label: type I enteroendocrine cell
definition: An enteroendocrine cell commonest in the duodenum and jejunum, rare in ileum, that secretes cholecystokinin. This cell type is involved in the regulation of digestive enzymes and bile.

label: GIP cell
definition: An enteroendocrine cell of duodenum and jejunum that produces gastric inhibitory peptide.

label: type L enteroendocrine cell
definition: A enteroendocrine cell type that is numerous in ileum, present in jejunum and large intestine, few in duodenum. This cell type produces glucagon-like immunoreactants (glicentin, glucagon-37, glucagon-29, GLP-1 and -2) and PYY.

label: type N enteroendocrine cell
definition: An enteroendocrine cell found in the ileum and jejunum that produces neurotensin.

label: type S enteroendocrine cell
definition: Scattered in duodenojejunal mucosa, this enteroendocrine cell secretes secretin and serotonin.

label: type TG enteroendocrine cell
definition: An enteroendocrine cell which produces a gastrin- and cholecystokinin-like peptide. The apical microvilli-rich plasma membrane is in open contact with the small intestine mucosa. This cell type is devoid of gastrin-17 but contains other fragments of the gastrin polypeptide.

label: ecto-epithelial cell of viscerocranial mucosa
definition: An epithelial cell of the mucosa associated with facial skeleton.

label: type X enteroendocrine cell
definition: An enteroendocrine cell found in the fundus and pylorus; this cell type has dense round secretory granules that contain ghrelin.

label: type III taste bud cell
definition: A taste receptor cell that is characterized by morphologically identifiable synaptic contacts with the gustatory nerve fibers and expression of the synaptic membrane protein-25 (SNAP-25) and NCAM.

label: type II taste cell
definition: A taste receptor cell that has a short microvilli, a projecting apical region, a large rounded nucleus, and expresses taste chemoreceptors thus making them the transducing cell for taste qualities.

label: type IV taste receptor cell
definition: A rounded, mitotically active stem cell which is the source of new cells of the taste bud; located basally.

label: type V taste receptor cell
definition: A cell type that forms the boundary with the surrounding epithelium.

label: type I taste bud cell
definition: A densely staining taste receptor cell that contains many dense vacuoles in their apical regions which project into the apical space and bear microvilli. This cell type serves as a supporting cell by surrounding and isolating the other cell types from each other; secrete a dense amorphous material that surrounds the microvilli in the taste pore. This cell type expresses a glial glutumate transporter, GLAST.
exact_synonyms: dark tongue cell|type I taste cell|type taste 1 cell

label: Y chromosome-bearing sperm cell
definition: A sperm bearing a Y chromosome. Chromosomal and genetic sex is established at fertilization in mammals and depends upon whether an X-bearing sperm or a Y-bearing sperm fertilizes the X-bearing ovum.

label: X chromosome-bearing sperm cell
definition: A sperm bearing an X chromosome. Chromosomal and genetic sex is established at fertilization in mammals and depends upon whether an X-bearing sperm or a Y-bearing sperm fertilizes the X-bearing ovum.

label: type I cell of carotid body
definition: A round or oval neuroepithelial cell that contacts other type I cells or capillaries. They occur in clusters that are surrounded by sheath cells (type-II cells) in the carotid body. This cell type is capable of secreting a number of neurotransmitters.

label: epithelial cell of thymus
definition: An epithelial cell of the thymus. Epithelial reticular cells are pleomorphic, stellate, non-phagocytic cells which seem to be supportive in function and are held together by desmosomes. They replace the fibroblastoid reticular cells found in other lymphoid organs. Other epithelial cells in the medulla have the ultrastructure of secretory cells. Although different epithelial cells throughout the thymus appear alike by light microscopy their ultrastructure and function varies.
exact_synonyms: epithelial cell of thymus gland|epithelial reticular cell of thymus|epithelial reticular cell|thymic epithelial cell

label: type-1 epithelial cell of thymus
definition: An epithelial cell with a well defined Golgi apparatus that makes up the continuous layer of cells bordering the thymic tissue beneath the capsule.

label: type-6 epithelial cell of thymus
definition: A thymic epithelial cell that has an eccentric, round, or irregularly shaped hetero or euchromatic nucleus. The hallmark of this cell type is the presence of vacuoles, which are clustered in one area of the cytoplasm in the vicinity of the nucleus. The vacuoles are small and acquire a grape-like form, occasionally showing delicate internal microvillous projections.
exact_synonyms: cystic thymic epithelial cells|large mTEC|large medullary thymic epithelial cells

label: type-4 epithelial cell of thymus
definition: An epithelial cell with high nuclear and cytoplasmic electron-density. This cell type is found in the deeper portions of the cortex but is more abundant in the medulla of the thymus.

label: type-3 epithelial cell of thymus
definition: A thymic epithelial cell with moderate nuclear and cytoplasmic electron-density. Scattered in the cortex, this cell type is predominant in the mid and deep cortex.

label: type-5 epithelial cell of thymus
definition: A thymic epithelial cell type with low nuclear and cytoplasmic electrondensity; has a round, euchromatic nucleus and occurs in small groups at the corticomedullary junction or scattered singly in the medulla.
exact_synonyms: undifferentiated mTEC|undifferentiated medullary thymic epithelial cell|undifferentiated thymic epithelial cell

label: type-2 epithelial cell of thymus
definition: An epithelial cell scattered in the cortex, predominant in the outer cortex with a large pale nucleus and a prominent nucleolus.

label: type-7 epithelial cell of thymus
definition: A small medullary thymic epithelial cell with a spindle shape, often arranged in groups and connected to each other by large desmosomes and interdigitations. The cytoplasm is sparse, with scanty organelles and thick bundles of cytokeratin.
exact_synonyms: spindle shaped mTEC|spindle shaped medullary thymic epithelial cell

label: type B synovial cell
definition: A resident stromal cell located in the synovial membrane and responsible for the production of immune-related cytokines and chemokines. This cell type secretes glycoproteins and hyaluronic acid, has abundant granular endoplasmic reticulum, but contains fewer vacuoles and vesicles.

label: type A synovial cell
definition: A synovial cell that is macrophage-like, characterized by surface ruffles or lamellipodia, plasma membrane invaginations and associated micropinocytotic vesicles, Golgi apparatus and little granular endoplasmic reticulum.

label: pigmented ciliary epithelial cell
definition: A cell that is part of pigmented ciliary epithelium. This cell type uptakes sodium and chloride ions from stromal interstitium and passes the ions to non-pigmented ciliary epithelial cells via gap junctions.

label: non-pigmented ciliary epithelial cell
definition: A cell that is part of non-pigmented ciliary epithelium. This cell type participates in aqueous humor formation by releasing solute, principally sodium and chloride ions received from pigmented epithelial cells via gap junctions, into the aqueous humor of the eye.

label: epithelial cell of distal tubule
definition: An epithelial cell of the distal convoluted tubule of the kidney that helps regulate systemic levels of potassium, sodium, calcium, and pH.

label: epithelial cell of proximal tubule
definition: An epithelial cell of the proximal tubule of the kidney.

label: brush border cell of the proximal tubule
definition: A brush border epithelial cell located in the proximal tubule of the kidney, essential for reabsorbing substances like glucose and amino acids from the glomerular filtrate. These cells also secrete organic ions, playing a crucial role in maintaining kidney homeostasis, including electrolyte and acid-base balance, and excreting metabolic waste.

label: epithelial cell of skin gland
definition: An epithelial cell of a skin gland.
exact_synonyms: epithelial cell of gland of skin

label: corticotroph
definition: A basophil chromphil cell of the anterior pitiutary gland that produce adrenocorticotropic hormone, melanocyte-stimulating hormone and lipotropin. This cell type is irregular in shape and has short dendritic processes which are inserted among other neighboring cells;

label: mammosomatotroph
definition: An acidophil cell of the anterior pituitary gland that produces both prolactin and growth hormone.

label: mammotroph
definition: An acidophilic cell of the anterior pituitary that produces prolactin.

label: somatotroph
definition: An acidophilic cell of the anterior pituitary that produces growth hormone, somatotropin.

label: endocrine-paracrine cell of prostate gland
definition: An ecto-epithelial cell of the prostate gland that secretes hormones.
exact_synonyms: glandular cell of prostate|neuro-epithelial cell of prostate gland

label: external supporting cell of vestibular epithelium
definition: An auditory epithelial support cell located in the vestibular epithelium that has many hallmarks of glial cells. This cell type express glial markers such as vimentin, S100, glutamate-aspartate transporter, low affinity neurotrophin receptor p75, glial fibrillary acidic protein, and proteolipid protein.

label: supporting cell of cochlea
definition: An epithelial supporting cell located in the cochlea.

label: supporting cell of vestibular epithelium
definition: A supporting cell of the vestibular epithelium.

label: external limiting cell of vestibular epithelium
definition: An external limiting cell found in the vestibular epithelium.

label: peripheral blood mesothelial cell
definition: A mesothelial cell capable of circulating in the blood by first losing its squamous character. This cell can incorporate into the regenerating mesothelium.

label: neural cell
definition: A cell that is part of the nervous system.

label: connective tissue cell
definition: A cell of the supporting or framework tissue of the body, which includes adipose tissue, cartilage, and bone. In vertebrates, this cell arises chiefly from the embryonic mesoderm and, in cranial regions, from neural crest.

label: embryonic cell (metazoa)
definition: A cell of the embryo.

label: embryonic stem cell
definition: A stem cell of embryonic origin.

label: amniocyte
definition: A cell of a fetus which is suspended in the amniotic fluid. Amniocytes are considered to arise from several tissues including fetal skin, the fetal urinary tract, umbilical cord, and the inner amniotic surface.

label: basal-myoepithelial cell of mammary gland
definition: A myoepithelial cell that is part of a mammary gland and is located in the basal layer. During lactation, a basal-myoepithelial cell of mammary gland contracts under the stimulation of oxytocin. In humans, a basal-myoepithelial cell of mammary gland can be identified by high levels of CD49f and low levels of EpCAM.
other_synonyms: B-Myo cell|BM|basal|basal myoepithelial cell|basal-myoepithelial cell|myoepithelial cell of lactiferous gland|basal cell of lactiferous duct

label: lactocyte
definition: A milk-producing glandular epithelial cell that is part of a mammary gland alveolus and differentiates from a luminal adaptive secretory precursor cell during secretory differentiation (also termed lactogenesis I). Following secretory activation (also termed lactogenesis II), a lactocyte is involved in the synthesis and/or transport of milk constituents including proteins, oligosaccharides, lactose, micronutrients, fat, hormones, immunoglobulins, and cytokines into the lumen of the lactating mammary gland.
exact_synonyms: epithelial cell of lactiferous gland|luminal cell of alveolus of lactiferous gland|mammary alveolar epithelial cell|mammary gland alveolar epithelial cell|lactaction-associated mammary epithelial cell|lactation-derived mammary cell

label: luminal epithelial cell of mammary gland
definition: A mammary epithelial cell that occurs in the lumen of the ductal and alveoli structure in the breast.

label: mammary gland epithelial cell
definition: An epithelial cell of the mammary gland.

label: bronchial epithelial cell
definition: An epithelial cell of the bronchus.

label: basal epithelial cell of tracheobronchial tree
definition: An epithelial cell type that lacks the columnar shape typical for other respiratory epithelial cells. This cell type is able to differentiate into other respiratory epithelial cells in response to injury.

label: undifferentiated cell of bronchus epithelium
definition: An undifferentiated columnar cell of the bronchus epithelium

label: multiciliated epithelial cell of the bronchus
definition: A multi-ciliated epithelial cell located in the bronchus epithelium, characterized by a columnar shape and motile cilia on its apical surface.
exact_synonyms: ciliated epithelial cell of the bronchus

label: neural crest derived adipocyte
definition: An adipocyte derived from a neural crest cell.

label: preadipocyte
definition: An undifferentiated fibroblast that can be stimulated to form a fat cell.

label: brown preadipocyte
definition: A preadipocyte that is capable of differentiating into a brown adipocyte. This cell type expresses uncoupling protein-1, PPAR-gamma, PR-domain-containing 16; and PGC-1alpha (peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-gamma (PPARgamma) coactivator-1alpha).

label: buccal mucosa cell
definition: An endothelial cell that lines the oral cavitiy including the mucosa of the gums, the palate, the lip, and the cheek.

label: keratinocyte stem cell
definition: A stem cell found in the basal layer of the epidermis, hair follicle, and sebaceous gland, characterised by its quiescent nature, high proliferative potential, and capacity for long-term self-renewal. This cell maintains epidermal homeostasis by producing transit-amplifying cells that differentiate to replenish the stratified squamous epithelium.

label: CD56-positive, CD161-positive immature natural killer cell, human
definition: A natural killer cell that is developmentally immature, has the phenotype CD34-negative, CD56-positive, CD117-positive, CD122-positive,and CD161-positive.

label: prostate stem cell
definition: A prostate epithelial cell that is CD133-positive, CD44-positive, integrin A2beta3-high. This cell is a stem cell for the prostate epithelium.

label: luminal cell of prostate epithelium
definition: The exocrine cell of the prostate, this epithelial cell secretes prostatic acid phosphotase and PSA, and is dependent on androgen hormones for survival.

label: basal cell of prostate epithelium
definition: An undifferentiated cell of the prostate epithelium that lacks secretory activity.

label: circulating endothelial cell
definition: A circulating endothelial cell of the phenotype CD146-positive, CD105-positive, CD45-negative. This cell type is indicative of recent vascular damage.

label: decidual natural killer cell, human
definition: A natural killer cell subset that is found in the decidual of the uterus and is CD56-high, Galectin-1-positive and CD16-negative. This cell type represents the most abundant immune cell type in the decidual during the first trimester of pregnancy.

label: CD56-negative, CD161-positive immature natural killer cell, human
definition: A natural killer cell that is developmentally immature, has the phenotype CD34-negative, CD56-negative, CD117-positive, CD122-positive,and CD161-positive.

label: CD27-low, CD11b-low immature natural killer cell, mouse
definition: An immature natural killer cell that is NK1.1-positive, DX5-positive, Ly49-positive, CD27-low and CD11b-low. This cell type is found in high numbers in the liver.

label: Dx5-negative, NK1.1-positive immature natural killer cell, mouse
definition: An immature natural killer cell that is NK1.1-positive and DX-5 negative.

label: CD27-high, CD11b-high natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A mature natural killer cell that is CD27-high and CD11b-high. This cell type is capable of interferon-gamma secretion.

label: CD27-low, CD11b-high natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A CD27-low, CD11b-high natural killer cell that has a higher threshold of activation due to higher expression of inhibitory receptors.

label: CD27-high, CD11b-low natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A natural killer cell that is CD27-high and CD11b-low.

label: endocardial cell
definition: An endothelial cell that lines the intracavitary lumen of the heart, separating the circulating blood from the underlying myocardium. This cell type releases a number of vasoactive substances including prostacyclin, nitrous oxide and endothelin.
exact_synonyms: endocardial endothelial cell|endothelial cell of endocardium

label: progenitor cell of endocrine pancreas
definition: A progenitor cell that is able to differentiate into the pancreas alpha, beta and delta endocrine cells. This cell type expresses neurogenin-3 and Isl-1.
exact_synonyms: pancreatic endocrine progenitor|pancreatic islet progenitor cell

label: gestational hematopoietic stem cell
definition: A hematopoietic stem cell that exists during embryogenesis.

label: fetal liver hematopoietic progenitor cell
definition: A hematopoietic stem cell that resides in the fetal liver. In mice, this cell type is first observed at E10.5. This cell type is MHC-positive, HSA-positive, AA4.1-positive, CD45-positive, Sca-1 positive, CD150-positive, CD48-negative and CD244-negative.

label: yolk sac hematopoietic stem cell
definition: A hematopoietic stem found in the yolk sac. In mice, this cell type is Sca-1-negative, CD45-negative, MHC-negative, HSA-positive, AA4.1-positive, CD44-positive.

label: primitive red blood cell
definition: A large nucleated basophilic erythrocyte found in mammalian embryos. This cell type arises from the blood islands of yolk sacs and expresses different types of hemoglobins (beta-H1, gamma-1 and zeta) than adult erythrocytes. Considered a type of erythroblast as this cell type can enucleate in circulation.

label: primitive reticulocyte
definition: A primitive erythrocyte that has undergone enucleation. This cell type is 3-6 fold bigger than the fetal derived erythrocytes that they co-circulate with during fetal development. Expresses epsilon-gamma hemoglobin chains.

label: fetal derived definitive erythrocyte
definition: A fetal liver derived enucleated erythrocyte. This erythrocyte resembles adult erythrocytes in that they are small (3- to 6- times smaller than primitive erythrocytes) and produce adult hemaglobins.

label: pyrenocyte
definition: Derived from the Greek word pyren (the pit of a stone fruit), this is a transient nucleated cell type that results from exclusion of the nucleus from the primitive erythrocyte.

label: placental hematopoietic stem cell
definition: A hematopoietic stem cell of the placenta. This cell type is first observed E10.5 This cell type may give rise to fetal liver hematopoietic stem cells.

label: AGM hematopoietic stem cell
definition: A hematopoietic stem cell from the aorta-gonad-mesonephros region of the developing embryo. First seen at E10.5 in mouse embryos. May give rise to fetal liver HSC.

label: primitive erythroid progenitor
definition: A progenitor cell that is capable of forming colonies of primitive erythrocytes in the blood island of the yolk sac. First arrive at E7.5 in mouse and expresses CD41.

label: cerebellar granule cell precursor
definition: A cell located in the outermost proliferative zone of the external germinal layer that can differentiate into astroglial cells and granule cells. This cell type is glial fibrillary acidic protein-positive and HNK1-positive.

label: keratocyte
definition: A keratocyte is a specialized fibroblast residing in the cornea stroma that has a flattened, dendritic morphology; located between the lamellae with a large flattened nucleus, and lengthy processes which communicate with neighboring cells. This corneal layer, representing about 85-90% of corneal thickness, is built up from highly regular collagenous lamellae and extracellular matrix components. Keratocytes play the major role in keeping it transparent, healing its wounds, and synthesizing its components. This cell type secretes collagen I, V, VI, and keratan sulfate.

label: cortical thymic epithelial cell
definition: An epithelial cell of the cortical portion of the thymus. Epithelial cells in this region are required for positive selection of CD8-positive T cells.

label: medullary thymic epithelial cell
definition: An epithelial cell of the medullary thymus. This cell type expresses a diverse range of tissue-specific antigens. This promiscuous gene expression is a cell-autonomous property of medullary epithelial cells and is maintained during the entire period of thymic T cell output.

label: myometrial cell
definition: A smooth muscle cell of the myometrium that enlarges and stretches during pregnancy, and contracts in response to oxytocin.

label: trabecular meshwork cell
definition: An ocular connective tissue cell that is part of the eye's trabecular meshwork and is directly responsible for regulating the outflow of aqueous humor from the anterior chamber of the eye, thereby maintaining proper intraocular pressure.

label: respiratory tract epithelial cell
definition: An epithelial cell of the respiratory tract epithelium. These cells have an endodermal origin.

label: fungal spore
definition: A differentiated form of a fungus produced during or as a result of an asexual or sexual reproductive process; usually a cell with a thick cell wall that stores and protects one or more nuclei. Spores may be produced in response to, and are characteristically resistant to, adverse environmental conditions.

label: respiratory tract goblet cell
definition: A simple columnar epithelial cell that secretes mucin. Rough endoplasmic reticulum, mitochondria, the nucleus, and other organelles are concentrated in the basal portion. The apical plasma membrane projects microvilli to increase surface area for secretion.
exact_synonyms: respiratory goblet cell|respiratory mucosa goblet cells

label: myotube
definition: A transversely striated, multinucleated syncytial muscle cell, formed by the fusion of myoblasts during muscle development.

label: growth hormone releasing hormone secreting cell
definition: A peptide hormone secreting cell that secretes growth hormone releasing hormone.

label: ear hair cell
definition: A hair cell of the ear that contains the organs of balance and hearing.

label: Schwann cell precursor
definition: A multipotent progenitor cell that develops from a migratory neural crest cell. The schwann cell precursor is embedded among axons, with minimal extracellular space separating them from nerve cell membranes. This cell lacks a basal lamina, which distinguishes it from more mature Schwann cells. In rodents, cadherin-19 (Cdh19) serves as a specific marker for this developmental stage.

label: non-myelinating Schwann cell
definition: A glial cell that ensheaths multiple small diameter axons in the peripheral nervous system. The non-myelinating Schwann cell is embedded among neurons (axons) with minimal extracellular spaces separating them from nerve cell membranes and has a basal lamina. Cells can survive without an axon present. These cells can de-differentiate into immature Schwann cells.

label: immature Schwann cell
definition: A glial cell that develops from a Schwann cell precursor. The immature Schwann cell is embedded among neurons (axons) with minimal extracellular spaces separating them from nerve cell membranes and has a basal lamina. Cells can survive without an axon present. Immature Schwann cell can be found communally ensheathing large groups of axons.

label: immature Vgamma2-positive fetal thymocyte
definition: A double negative thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing a Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive and is found in the fetal thymus.

label: meningothelial cell
definition: A neurecto-epithelial cell found in the arachnoid villi of dura mater. This cell type facilitates flow of cerebrospinal fluid into the blood.

label: oospore
definition: An asexual spore formed by Oomycetes; formed upon fertilization of an oosphere.

label: uninucleate conidium
definition: A conidium that has only one nucleus.

label: multinucleate conidium
definition: A conidium that has more than one nucleus.

label: conidium of conidiophore head
definition: A uninucleate spore formed on specialized cells or projections, sterigma, of a conidiophore head.

label: uninucleate macroconidium
definition: A macroconidium that has only one nucleus.

label: blastoconidium
definition: An oblong or round asexual spore formed from conidial chains.

label: multinucleate macroconidium
definition: A macroconidium that has more than one nucleus.

label: arthroconidium
definition: Cylindrical spore formed by development and compartmentation of hyphae; the hyphae are often supporting blastoconidiophores.

label: multinucleate arthroconidium
definition: An arthroconidium that has more than one nucleus.

label: uninucleate arthroconidium
definition: An arthroconidium that has only one nucleus.

label: uninucleate blastconidium
definition: A blastoconidium that has only one nucleus.

label: multinucleate blastoconidium
definition: A blastoconidium that has more than one nucleus.

label: intermediate monocyte
definition: A monocyte that has characteristics of both patrolling and inflammatory monocytes.

label: CD141-positive myeloid dendritic cell
definition: A myeloid dendritic cell found in the blood, lymph nodes, tonsil, bone marrow, and spleen that is CD141-positive (BDCA-3), XCR1-positive, and Clec9A-positive. This cell-type can cross-present antigen to CD8-positive T cells and can produce inteferon-beta.

label: Gr1-high classical monocyte
definition: A resident monocyte that is Gr-1 high, CD43-negative, CX3CR1-negative, CD115-positive, and B220-negative.

label: CD14-low, CD16-positive monocyte
definition: A patrolling monocyte that is CD14-low and CD16-positive.

label: CD14-positive, CD16-positive monocyte
definition: A CD14-positive monocyte that is also CD16-positive and CCR2-negative.

label: Gr1-positive, CD43-positive monocyte
definition: An intermediate monocyte that is Gr1-positive, CD43-positive.

label: CD1c-positive myeloid dendritic cell
definition: A myeloid dendritic cell that is CD1c-positive.

label: fraction B/C precursor B cell
definition: A precursor B cell that is AA4-positive, IgM-negative, CD19-positive, CD43-positive and HSA-positive.

label: mature dendritic epithelial T cell precursor
definition: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that has as part a Vgamma3 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative. This cell-type is found in the fetal thymus with highest numbers occurring at E17-E18.

label: Peyer's patch B cell
definition: A resting mature B cell within the Peyer's patch that is CD19-positive, B220-positive, IgM-positive, AA4-negative, CD23-positive, CD43-negative, and CD5-negative.

label: mature Vgamma2-positive fetal thymocyte
definition: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative. This cell-type is found in the fetal thymus.

label: fetal thymocyte
definition: A thymocyte found in the fetal thymus.

label: gamma-delta thymocyte
definition: A post-natal thymocyte expressing components of the gamma-delta T cell receptor. This cell type is always double-negative (i.e. CD4-negative, CD8-negative).

label: immature Vgamma2-positive thymocyte
definition: A double negative post-natal thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing a Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive.

label: mature Vgamma2-positive thymocyte
definition: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain containing Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative.

label: immature Vgamma2-negative thymocyte
definition: A double negative post-natal thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that does not contain a Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-positive.

label: mature Vgamma2-negative thymocyte
definition: A thymocyte that has a T cell receptor consisting of a gamma chain that does not contain the Vgamma2 segment, and a delta chain. This cell type is CD4-negative, CD8-negative and CD24-negative.

label: pancreatic stellate cell
definition: A cell that is found in the periacinar space of the exocrine pancreas and in perivascular and periductal regions of the pancreas, and has long cytoplasmic processes that encircle the base of the acinus. Expresses several intermediate filament proteins including vimentin and nestin. Shares many of the characteristics of hepatatic stellate cells, but not stellate cells of the central nervous system. Upon activation, this cell type undergoes morphological and gene expression changes that make the cell suggestive of being a type of myofibroblast.

label: Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte
definition: A gamma-delta receptor that expresses Vgamma1.1 but does not express Vdelta6.3 chains in the T-cell receptor.

label: Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte
definition: A gamma-delta receptor that expresses Vgamma1.1-Vdelta6.3 chains in the T-cell receptor.

label: mature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte
definition: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte that is CD24-negative.

label: immature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte
definition: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-negative thymocyte that is CD24-positive.

label: immature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte
definition: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte that is CD24-positive.

label: mature Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte
definition: A Vgamma1.1-positive, Vdelta6.3-positive thymocyte that is CD24-negative.

label: primitive erythroid lineage cell
definition: An immature or mature cell of the first erythroid lineage to arise during embryonic development.

label: hemangioblast
definition: A pluripotent cell in the yolk sac that can give rise to mesenchymal cells including erythrocytes and endothelial cells.

label: mature T cell
definition: A T cell that expresses a T cell receptor complex and has completed T cell selection.

label: immature T cell
definition: A T cell that has not completed T cell selection.

label: nucleated reticulocyte
definition: A reticulocyte that retains the nucleus and other organelles. Found in birds, fish, amphibians and reptiles.

label: enucleated reticulocyte
definition: A reticulocyte lacking a nucleus and showing a basophilic reticulum under vital staining due to the presence of ribosomes.

label: DN2a thymocyte
definition: A DN2 thymocyte that is Kit-hi.

label: DN2b thymocyte
definition: A DN2 thymocyte that is Kit-low.

label: early T lineage precursor
definition: A pro-T cell that is lin-negative, CD25-negative, CD127-negative, CD44-positive and kit-positive.

label: CD11b-positive, CD27-positive natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A mature natural killer cell that is CD11b-positive and CD27-positive.

label: resting double-positive thymocyte
definition: A double-positive, alpha-beta thymocyte that is small and not proliferating.

label: double-positive blast
definition: A double-positive thymocyte that is large (i.e. has a high forward scatter signal in flow cytometry) and is actively proliferating.

label: CD69-positive double-positive thymocyte
definition: A double-positive thymocyte that is CD69-positive and has begun positive selection.

label: CD4-intermediate, CD8-positive double-positive thymocyte
definition: A double-positive thymocyte that is undergoing positive selection, has high expression of the alpha-beta T cell receptor, is CD69-positive, and is in the process of down regulating the CD4 co-receptor.

label: CD4-positive, CD8-intermediate double-positive thymocyte
definition: A double-positive thymocyte that is undergoing positive selection, has high expression of the alpha-beta T cell receptor, is CD69-positive, and is in the process of down regulating the CD8 co-receptor.

label: CD24-positive, CD4 single-positive thymocyte
definition: A CD4-positive, CD8-negative thymocyte that is CD24-positive and expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor.

label: CD69-positive, CD4-positive single-positive thymocyte
definition: A CD4-positive, CD8-negative thymocyte that expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor and is CD69-positive.

label: CD24-positive, CD8 single-positive thymocyte
definition: A CD8-positive, CD4-negative thymocyte that is CD24-positive and expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor.

label: CD69-positive, CD8-positive single-positive thymocyte
definition: A CD8-positive, CD4-negative thymocyte that expresses high levels of the alpha-beta T cell receptor and is CD69-positive.

label: mature CD4 single-positive thymocyte
definition: A mature CD4-positive, CD8-negative alpha-beta T cell found in the thymus that is CD24-low and has high expression of the T cell receptor.

label: mature CD8 single-positive thymocyte
definition: A mature CD8-positive, CD4-negative alpha-beta T cell found in the thymus that is CD24-low and has high expression of the T cell receptor.

label: NK1.1-positive natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A mature NK cell that is NK1.1-positive.

label: NKGA2-positive natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is NKGA2-positive.

label: Ly49D-positive natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49D-positive.

label: CD94-positive natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-positive.

label: CD94-negative, Ly49CI-negative natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-negative and Ly49Cl-negative.

label: Ly49CI-positive natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49Cl-positive.

label: Ly49H-positive natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49H-positive.

label: Ly49D-negative natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49D-negative.

label: Ly49CI-negative natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49Cl-negative.

label: CD94-negative natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-negative.

label: Ly49H-negative natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is Ly49H-negative.

label: CD94-positive Ly49CI-positive natural killer cell, mouse
definition: A NK1.1-positive T cell that is CD94-positive and Ly49Cl-positive.

label: tether cell
definition: A specialized hair cell that has an elongated kinocilium upon which an otolith accretes. The tether cell then anchors the otolith in place.

label: mammary stem cell
definition: A multi-fate stem cell that is the source of cells for growth of the mammary gland during puberty and gestation. This cell type gives rise to both the luminal and myoepithelial cell types of the gland, and have been shown to have the ability to regenerate the entire organ in mice. This cell type also plays an important role in carcinogenesis of the breast. This cell type is Lin-, CD24-positive, CD29-hi.

label: oligodendrocyte precursor cell
definition: A proliferative and migratory glial progenitor cell that derives from a neural stem cell and resides within the central nervous system. It possesses the capacity to differentiate into a committed oligodendrocyte progenitor (COP) through a well-defined series of maturation steps, ultimately giving rise to a myelinating oligodendrocyte (MOL). In mice and humans, it is characterized by the expression of specific molecular markers, including Pdgfra, Cspg4 (also known as NG2) and Olig2.

label: CD4-negative, CD8-alpha-negative, CD11b-positive dendritic cell
definition: CD4-negative, CD8-alpha-negative, CD11b-positive dendritic cell is a conventional dendritic cell that is CD11b-positive, CD4-negative, CD8-alpha-negative and is CD205-positive.

label: CD8-alpha-negative plasmacytoid dendritic cell
definition: A CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell that is CD8-alpha-negative and CD4-positive.

label: CD8-alpha-positive plasmacytoid dendritic cell
definition: A CD11c-low plasmacytoid dendritic cell that is CD8-alpha-positive and CD4-positive.

label: epidermal Langerhans cell
definition: A Langerhans cell that is in the epidermis and is CD45-positive, MHCII-positive, and CD11b-positive.

label: langerin-positive dermal dendritic cell
definition: A dermal dendritic cell that is langerin-positive and CD103-positive.

label: langerin-negative dermal dendritic cell
definition: A dermal dendritic cell that is langerin-negative, CD103-negative, and CD11b-positive.

label: CD8-alpha-negative thymic conventional dendritic cell
definition: A conventional thymic dendritic cell that is CD8-alpha-negative.

label: CD103-positive dendritic cell
definition: A conventional dendritic cell that is CD103-positive. This cell type is usually found in non-lymphoid tissue.

label: adipose dendritic cell
definition: A F4/80-negative dendritic cell located in adipose tissue.

label: SIRPa-positive adipose dendritic cell
definition: An adipose dendritic cell that is SIRPa-positive.

Perineurial cells historically have been referred to as fibroblasts because of shape; however, unlike fibroblasts, a perineurial cell: does not have a compact nucleus and large endoplasmic reticulum; does have a double basement membrane opposed to a single basal lamina; is carefully joined to other perineurial cells by tight junctions into a single sheet as opposed to arranged in a large mass; and finally, can surround a small axon bundle at a nerve terminal whereas a fibroblast cannot.

label: acinar cell of salivary gland
definition: An acinar cell that is part of the salivary gland epithelium, responsible for synthesizing and secreting the primary saliva essential for oral digestion, antimicrobial defense, and mucosal immunity. It features apical-basal polarity with apical secretory granules, and tight junctions that maintain polarity and regulate calcium-dependent saliva exocytosis triggered by parasympathetic and sympathetic signals (Ambudkar, 2015). This cell functions in coordination with contractile myoepithelial cells, which aid saliva flow through the ducts into the oral cavity (Khan et al., 2022). In mice and humans, acinar cell development relies on the transcription factor SOX2 (Emmerson et al., 2017), with self-renewal achieved primarily through acinar cell self-duplication and supported by progenitor populations during injury and regeneration (Aure et al., 2016).

label: otic fibrocyte
definition: A mesenchymal cell within the inner ear, specifically localised to supportive connective tissues such as the spiral ligament and spiral limbus. This cell has specialised structural and molecular adaptations, and it contributes to the homeostasis of the cochlear environment by participating in ionic regulation crucial for auditory function.

label: type II spiral ligament fibrocyte
definition: A spiral ligament fibrocyte that is located near the spiral prominence between the basilar crest and the stria and plays an important role in potassium recycling by actively pumping K+ from the extracellular space and facilitating transcellular K+ transport through gap junctions toward Type I fibrocytes. In mice, Type II fibrocytes express connexin 26 (Gjb2) and connexin 30 (Gjb6) as part of the mesenchymal gap junction system, as well as the Na‑K‑2Cl cotransporter NKCC1.

label: type V spiral ligament fibrocyte
definition: A spiral ligament fibrocyte located in the suprastrial region above the stria vascularis, distinguished from other fibrocytes by their unique expression of COX-1 in guinea pigs and end-foot structures that directly contact capillaries (Dai and Shi, 2011). This fibro-vascular coupling enables type V fibrocytes to regulate cochlear blood flow by translating Ca²⁺ signals into capillary vasodilation via COX-1-derived prostaglandins. This cell also participates in K⁺ recycling, expressing Na,K-ATPase (ATP1A1, ATP1B1) in mice and humans, and connexin 26/30 gap junctions enabling intercellular K⁺ transport within the spiral ligament syncytium (Peeleman et al., 2020).

label: type IV spiral ligament fibrocyte
definition: A spiral ligament fibrocyte that is located in the triangular space inferior to the crista basilaris (basilar crest). This cell is spindle-shaped and expresses NKCC1 but minimal to no Na,K-ATPase (ATP1A1, ATP1B1) in mice and humans, and lacks connexin 26/30 in mice, indicating it does not participate in K⁺ recycling, unlike type II fibrocytes. Type IV fibrocyte is uniquely characterised by strong expression of connective tissue growth factor (CTGF) in mice, suggesting roles in tissue remodelling and paracrine signalling to other cochlear cells.

label: type III spiral ligament fibrocyte
definition: A spiral ligament fibrocyte that is located in the deepest part of the inferior spiral ligament, directly lining the bony otic capsule. Distinguished from ion-transporting Type I and II fibrocytes, it utilises actin-myosin stress fibres and anchoring interactions to regulate basilar membrane tension. It has an elongated morphology, is most numerous in the basal, high-frequency cochlea, and expresses contractile and cytoskeletal proteins in mice, including α‑smooth muscle actin, non‑muscle myosin II, caldesmon, and the water channel Aquaporin‑1(Mahendrasingam et al., 2011; Kelly et al., 2012).

label: type I spiral ligament fibrocyte
definition: A spiral ligament fibrocyte that underlies the stria vascularis and is part of a mesenchymal gap junction network that regulates ionic homeostasis of the endolymph. In mice, expression of connexin 26 (Gjb2) and connexin 30 (Gjb6) serves as a distinguishing molecular signature.
